title: The thickness was a little disappointing…
text:
The thickness was a little disappointing…. [[VIDEOID:cf8121c64161a87b023043312b62b00e]] Very colorful and all the pieces stay on. I was expecting something more full looking. This isn’t very thick, but it does allow my main door to close easily with the screen door. Just an average rating.

Trust you found this review honest and helpful:-)
